about: The kept 28 October examples the store shows, and where (sections/hs3-chat.liquid). Built by tools/print-art/example-assets.py from the PNGs on branch examples/2026-10-28; review.md there and here says why each was kept. Every image is labelled Example on the page.

images.alt: Example: a pug lying in autumn leaves, soft-eyed and still, in vintage screenprint. Sentimental.
Example: the same pug standing in the leaves with a head tilt and a small smile, in vintage screenprint. Warm with a wink.
Example: the same pug bounding at you through flying leaves, tongue out, in vintage screenprint. Hilarious.
Example mug art: a golden retriever puppy asleep on a rug, chin on its paws, in cut-paper collage. Sentimental.
Example mug art: the same puppy rolling belly-up on the rug with its paws in the air, in cut-paper collage. Hilarious.
Example portrait art: a golden retriever puppy resting its chin on a paw, eyes half closed, in cut-paper collage. Sentimental.
Example blanket art: a repeated pattern of a sleepy golden retriever puppy among leaf sprigs and hearts, in cut-paper collage. Sentimental.
Example mug art: a pug leaping into autumn leaves with its tongue out, in vintage screenprint. Hilarious.
